title: 353. Strobogrammatic Number II

examples.explanation: These are all length-2 strings whose rotation mirrors correctly with a non-zero lead.
Only 0, 1, and 8 rotate to themselves as single digits.

hints: Build the strings from the outside in, wrapping inner results with each rotation pair.
The outermost pair cannot use 0 as the leading digit.
Recurse with length n - 2 until reaching length 0 (empty middle) or 1 (0, 1, 8).
